jr.title: Blog & journal
jr.sub: Articles that bring people from search to the shop: write, check in three steps, then schedule or publish.
jr.off: The journal is switched off: the shop's /journal page still says “Coming soon”. You can write, check and publish; customers see the articles once you switch it on in the card below.
jr.emptySub: “New article” starts one. Ideas, drafts and put-away articles stay here; nothing is deleted.

card.d: Whether customers see the journal, and its numbers. Off as it ships.
card.readOnly: Only someone who may publish articles can change this.
card.on: Show the journal on the shop
card.relatedProducts: Products in an article's product block (0 = none)
card.reviewByAnother: Nobody passes the review of his own article
card.aiNote: Honest line beside an AI author (empty = the shop's own words)

e.linkHelp: The address: {path}. Latin letters, digits and hyphens; a Bengali title needs one typed.
e.author: Author
e.bodyHelp: A blank line between paragraphs. ## heading · ### sub-heading · - bullet · 1. numbered · > tip: … · > note: … · [products] where the product block goes · **bold** · [words](/collections/polos) for a link.
e.productsHere: The product block shows here ({n} products).
e.gaps: Still missing before it can go live: {fields}
e.liveNow: This article is on the shop now.
e.readOnly: You can see this article; changing it needs the writer's or publisher's permission.

sh.title: Categories & authors
sh.sub: The journal's sections and the names its articles are signed with. Put away, never deleted.
sh.catsSub: Main categories and their sub-categories (two levels).
sh.authorsSub: An AI author is always shown as one on the shop.
sh.parentNone: None — this is a main category
sh.reviewer: Checked-by line (only a real person's name)

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile; the page shows the latest now. Make your change again.
err.SLUG_TAKEN: That link is taken in this language; pick another.
err.WRONG_STATE: That step is not open in this state.
err.NOT_READY: Not ready to go live: {fields} missing.
err.OWN_ARTICLE: You wrote this article; another person passes its checks.
err.ARCHIVED: A put-away article cannot be changed; restore it first.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the permission for this.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
err.LINKS_MISSING: Required links missing (Topic plan): {paths}. Add them to the words first.
err.ALIKE: A very close article or topic exists: {fields}. Press again to add it anyway.
err.BRIEF_TAKEN: That topic has its brief already; open it from the Topic plan.
err.BRIEF_MISSING: This topic needs its brief before writing starts: press “Brief”.
err.AI_OFF: AI drafting is off: turn on AI for the shop and “AI first drafts” first.
err.DAILY_LIMIT: Today’s AI drafts are used up ({fields} a day). Try again tomorrow, or write it by hand.
err.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI writer did not answer; try again in a while.

pl.title: Topic plan
pl.sub: Which articles to write, and how they link: one pillar guide per subject, its supporting articles around it, all pointing at one shop page.
pl.clustersSub: A cluster is one subject: the pillar article, its supporting articles and the topics still to write.
pl.noClusters: No cluster yet. Add the first one on the right.
pl.addPost: Add an article to this cluster
pl.name: Name (English)
pl.newClusterSub: One subject people search for, such as polo care or winter layering.
pl.looseSub: Nothing in the plan points at these yet; add each to the cluster it belongs to.
pl.looseNone: Every article is in a cluster.
pl.newTopicSub: Your own topic is approved at once; a writer's waits for the owner's yes.
pl.isPillar: This is the cluster's pillar article
pl.author: Writer
pl.alikeNone: Not alike any article or topic.
pl.alikeAgain: A very close article or topic exists: {fields}. Press again to add it anyway.
pl.started: The draft is made; opening the editor.
pl.how1: Make a cluster for each subject and choose the shop page its articles lead to.
pl.how2: Add topics: what to write and what people search. Very close topics are caught before they are added.
pl.how3: Start writing makes the draft inside the cluster; mark one article as its pillar.
pl.how4: The list shows which links each article still needs. With the rule on, an article goes live only with them.

card.d: Which links the articles of a cluster must carry, and how alike two topics may be. Refusing to publish is off as it ships.
card.requireLinks: Refuse publishing while a required link is missing
card.linkPillar: Supporting articles link to their pillar
card.linkTarget: Articles link to the cluster's shop page
card.pillarLinksAll: The pillar links to every live article of its cluster
card.dupWarn: Very close from (%) — needs a second press

pl.queueOwner: Topics from the writers wait here, month by month. Say yes or no one by one, or approve a whole month at once; a very close one is held for you.
pl.queueAuto: Topics are approved by themselves now; only the ones held for you (very close to an article or topic) wait here.
pl.digestEmpty: Nothing was decided by itself in these days.

acard.d: Who decides which articles get written, and whether finished articles go live by themselves. The owner decides, as it ships.
acard.holdAlike: Hold very close topics for the owner
acard.autoPublish: Publish by itself once the last check passes (only with “By itself”)

br.title: Brief
br.sub: Chosen before a single word is written: the topic, its language, how many words and the keywords. The rest helps the writer.
br.topicPick: Choose a topic from the plan
br.topicNewHelp: A new topic joins the Topic plan; a writer’s waits for the owner’s yes.
br.keywordsHelp: Separated by commas; the first one leads.
br.i_info: To know (a guide or an answer)
br.mustIncludeHelp: Sizes, care steps, prices from the live rules — only what is true.
br.linksHelp: One shop path a line, e.g. /collections/polos.
br.shotListHelp: One photo a line; our own photos first.
br.img_library: Own photos first, then the picture library
br.img_aiAsk: An AI picture only with a yes each time
br.none: No open topic. Add one on the Topic plan, or type a new one here.

card.d: How a new brief starts, and whether writing waits for one. As it ships writing does not wait.
card.wordsMin: Fewest words a brief may ask
card.wordsMax: Most words a brief may ask

ai.d: Writes a first draft of the article from this brief, in its language. A person still edits it and it passes the three review steps.
ai.go: Write the first draft with AI
ai.done: The draft is ready; the editor opens.
ai.donePractice: Practice draft ready (no AI key yet); the editor opens.
ai.used: {n} of {max} drafts in the last 24 hours.
ai.b_aiOff: AI is off for the whole shop (AI section).
ai.b_off: AI drafts are off — turn them on in the card below.
ai.b_notApproved: The topic waits for the owner’s yes first.
ai.b_started: The article is already started; open it.
ai.b_limit: Today’s AI drafts are used up.
ai.practiceBox: Practice text from the practice writer — no AI key is entered yet. Rewrite it before the review.

card.d: Off as it ships. It also needs AI on for the whole shop.
card.enabled: Offer “Write the first draft with AI”
card.dailyMax: Most AI drafts in a day
